name: Famine
value: Risk of Famine in Sudan; none newly confirmed
summary: IPC warns famine risk is rising in Darfur and Kordofan; no area newly classified as Famine found as of 20 Nov
state: An IPC alert in October said famine risk is rising in Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan as drought compounds the war (AllAfrica, 13 Oct; KSAT). WFP said on 12 Nov that 900,000 people in Sudan have lost food assistance because of funding cuts (Sudan Tribune). These are risk warnings, not a new Famine classification; searches on 20 Nov found none, so Watch holds.
for_you: Famine risk in Sudan drives aid appeals and onward displacement into Chad, South Sudan and Egypt. FCDO advises against all travel to Sudan.
rubric_hit: Watch: IPC 'risk of famine' alert for Greater Darfur and Kordofan; no new IPC Phase 5 classification found

sources.title: AllAfrica — IPC Sudan Food Insecurity and Malnutrition Alert

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.
